definitions.explanation: A polite and respectful way to refer to someone else's wife. Can also be used as a term of address for a married woman. Not used for one's own wife.

examples.japanese: {奥様|おくさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥様|おくさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{挨拶|あいさつ}→ご挨拶：23538_goaisatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I greeted the company president's wife.

examples.japanese: {奥様|おくさま}、⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。

notes:
{奥様|おくさま} is the polite/honorific form used when referring to someone else's wife or addressing a married woman respectfully.

FORMS:
- {奥様|おくさま}: polite/honorific (most respectful)
- ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧: polite but less formal (everyday use)
- {奥方|おくがた}: very formal, literary

WATCH OUT:
{奥様|おくさま} and ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧ are used only for someone else's wife, never for one's own. To refer to one's own wife, use ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ (neutral) or ⟦{家内|かない}→家内：00958_kanai⟧ (traditional).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧: wife (neutral, used for one's own wife)
- ⟦{家内|かない}→家内：00958_kanai⟧: my wife (humble, traditional)
- ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧: wife, bride (casual/regional)
